params.body:
The next part of the writing view: claims without a source in the margin, select to ask, and the version arrows.

- **Claims without a source.** A sentence that states a quantity and has no source under it gets a wavy red underline, the only red on the sheet, and a note in the margin: the line, where it stands, and three ways to close it: look for evidence (asked in the conversation), mark as our view, cut it. The line under the piece says when publishing waits for one.
- **Select to ask.** Select words in a paragraph or on a slide and an ask box opens there. The question goes to the conversation bound to that paragraph, shows in the chat as asked on it, and the answer lands as a suggestion on that paragraph, marked "Asked here".
- **Version arrows.** Every suggestion carries ‹ n of m ›: back to an earlier version, or, past the last one, a new version written for the same place. Each keeps its own sources; Accept takes the one shown.

## Needs the pipeline, safe without it

The matching pipeline pull request serves the claims, the marking as our view, and the versions. Without it: no claims show (the summary has none), and the version arrows answer with an error toast instead of changing anything.

## Checks

`npm run build` and `npm test` on a fresh worktree from main. Tried in a browser against a local pipeline: a selected paragraph asked "sharper, and less China-only", answered as a suggestion with three sources; a second version; a claim underlined with its note.
params.title: Studio: claims without a source in the margin, select to ask, version arrows
